facts.value: The application is done online through the central online portal for master's programs at Goethe University in cooperation with uni-assist e.V.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: Please upload all required documents such as CV and certificates through the upload function in the Uni-Assist portal and attach them to your application.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: No fees are charged for applying to master's programs at Goethe University. You do not have to pay a processing fee to uni-assist.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: For technical questions, please contact uni-assist directly.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro and Finance

facts.value: For content-related questions regarding the application, please contact the academic advisory service.
